title: Need a professional
text:
Need a professional. Easy to put together??? I don't think so. Nightmare, two experienced people took 4 hrs to get it done. Drawers aren't flush or even, they don't close evenly.

Shelves are small, don't expect to put appliances on them. I do like the counter top. Glad I have it , but never again buying without professional help.

product_metadata.title: Yaheetech Kitchen Island on Lockable Wheels with Bamboo Countertop, Rolling Kitchen Trolley Cart with 2 Drawers and Adjustable Shelves, Compartment Cabinets and Towel Bar, 38.5x18x36 Inches, White
features: 🥪FUNCTIONAL KITCHEN STORAGE: The mobile kitchen island is designed with 2 pull-out drawers on full extension metal slides to offer hide-away storage for silverware and napkins, and 4 open shelves and cabinet to store utensils and appliances neatly. The side towel bar keeps kitchen towels on hand.

🥪EASY MOBILITY: This kitchen island is perched atop 4 caster wheels that provide must-have maneuverability. With a four-wheel base, it can go anywhere you need it and the 2 locking casters can keep it in place if needed.
🥪ADJUSTABLE SHELF HEIGHT: The interior shelf of the cabinet and open shelves can be adjusted to three different heights (23.5cm/9.3”, 30cm/11.8”, 36.5cm/14.4”) to accommodate your storage needs.

🥪SIMPLE ASSEMBLY REQUIRED: This kitchen island cart comes with step-by-step assembly instruction and numbered parts and hardware to make sure you can set up it without difficulties. An Allen Key is also included for your convenience.

🥪ELEGANT ADDITION: This kitchen island cart sports a classic finish for a neutral and elegant look that can easily blend with your current indoor design. It also serves perfectly as a coffee bar or a place for cocktails when paired with counter-height stools.
